name: Sam
label: Missing discography and lyrics
who: I use Spotify on desktop and mobile, and I'm on a family plan that is also used on the TV. I care about browsing artist pages, discographies and lyrics, and I notice when those change.
value_for_money: Frustrated with the service being worse without any gain. One user says they mainly use SoundCloud with an adblocker, buy albums and say to 'screw the monthly subscription'. Another says they were about to cancel their family plan over an unwanted recommendation.
loyalty: Stays for the family plan and for the catalog while features are fixed. Would leave if artist pages and discographies stay removed, with some users naming SoundCloud, YouTube Music or Apple Music as options.
pain_points: Lyrics screen changed and harder to read
Desktop full screen shows only the album cover
Unwanted recommendations on the family TV
likes: Artist button fixed so it goes to the artist page
Apple Music lyric screen with synced colors
Lyrics used to be big with a fade effect
reasons_to_stay: They keep using the app for the family plan and for finding artists and albums. When a broken feature gets fixed, like the artist button, they are glad to have it back, and they accept workarounds like the discography menu.
tone: Exasperated and informal, with caps, profanity and sarcasm.
